summary.text: Chris Morrow, listed by Ballotpedia as Christopher Morrow, is a Democratic member of the Vermont House of Representatives for the Windham-Windsor-Bennington District, which he has represented since January 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia says he was born in Manchester Center, Vermont, and earned a master's degree from the University of Michigan.
